Entries.Message: Technically the member function 'pbdemodd3d11::Demodulator::Poll' can be const.
Entries.Assessment: False positive from shallow unique_ptr analysis: Poll mutates slot completion, mapped metric retirement, CPU FEC output and pending counters. A const lifecycle mutator would misstate ownership and thread-safety.

Entries.Message: Technically the member function 'pbdemodd3d11::Demodulator::Shutdown' can be const.
Entries.Assessment: False positive from shallow unique_ptr analysis: Shutdown drains GPU queries, retires texture leases, clears slots and changes the terminal lifecycle state. It must remain visibly mutating.

Entries.Message: Technically the member function 'pbrealcapturereplay::ReplayWriter::Finalize' can be const.
Entries.Assessment: False positive from shallow unique_ptr analysis: Finalize writes and flushes the footer, closes the partial file, publishes the final path and changes writer state. It must not be callable through a const writer.

Entries.Message: Possible null pointer dereference: readback
Entries.Assessment: False positive: Require throws on failed DiagnosticCpuReadback::Create; successful factory publishes a non-null candidate only after starting the worker. Every failure preserves output. Existing allocation/error-path and real worker tests exercise this contract.
